description: Feedback for one coaching round on one stage. Used as the input_schema of the forced submit_feedback tool.

verdict.description: ready = all required criteria met or partial. Advisory only; the learner can always move on.

criteria.description: One entry per rubric criterion for this stage (IDs from spec/02-rubric.md).

note.description: Short internal reason. Shown to facilitators, not learners.

strength.description: One sentence on what works, quoting the learner. Omit if nothing specific.

feedback.description: Learner-facing feedback in the learner's language. Under 120 words. No rewritten answers.

improved_since_last.description: Rounds 2-3 only: what got better since the previous round.

suggested_skills.description: Stage 6 only. Skills that look missing, with the reason tied to the learner's inputs/outputs.

uncovered_needs.description: Stage 6 only. AI skills the problem clearly needs that no catalog skill describes. These are outside the course; the app marks them 'Not covered'. Empty in most cases.
